customize.name: Elemental Dragons
customize.desc: An ancient race, who ruled Teyvat long before human existence. Dragons belong to the Light Realm.

customize.text: Kanna Kapatcir was the Electro Dragon Sovereign — a primordial being of Teyvat and one of the Seven Dragon Sovereigns.

customize.name: War of Funerary Flame
customize.desc: The war between the Dragon Lord Nibelung and the Heavenly Principles that took place 6,000 years ago.

customize.text: , an ancient civilization worshipped the Thunderbird.

Kanna Kapatcir's friend who gave it its name. The people of Tsurumi Island brought sacrifices to the Thunderbird, and Ruu asked to be sacrificed. In anger, Kanna Kapatcir destroyed the entire island after his death and placed it in a time loop.

customize.name: Beelzebul
customize.desc: The Electro Archon of Inazuma, known as Raiden Ei.

customize.text: For the sake of Inazuma's peace, Ei slew the Thunderbird and severed the connection between the primordial Electro energy and time itself, sealing the primordial Electro element away. As a result, no new Electro Dragon could be born, and Raiden Shogun controlled all lightning within Inazuma.

customize.name: Thunder Manifestation
customize.desc:
An abnormal Electro elemental life form. Although it might appear similar to an Oceanid, it does not possess her intelligence or memories.
That which drives the Thunder Manifestation is a much more primal fury.
It is said that these life forms will only descend like lightning upon places that play host to great lingering resentment, such as the fragmented Amakumo Peak, where the storm clouds ever roil. As long as the grudges of the land do not fade, so will the roaring thunder persist.

customize.text: An elemental being that emerged following the death of Kanna Kapatcir, driven by its fury.

customize.name: Hamayumi
customize.desc: A certain shrine maiden once owned this warbow. It was made with surpassing skill, and is both intricate and sturdy.

customize.name: Peculiar Pinion

A strange feather.
